# Complete archive owner, external compatibility requirements

Author ONLY a whole pluginSyncArchive.ts; no private predecessor helper/type/frame names supplied. Private design free. Actual public API is archive-public-api.d.ts; last two declarations describe retained imports, not exports to add. Imports allowed node:fs/promises chmod,lstat,mkdir,readFile,readdir,writeFile; node:path dirname/join/posix/resolve; node:util promisify; node:zlib gzip/gunzip; retained ./pluginSyncPath.js two ports. Use no external dependency/new security rule. Author only designated packets/own new outputs, no repository/predecessor/history/tests/dependency bodies/userdata/network/process/system actions. <=400 nonblank. Freeze first-ready raw and receipt BEFORE review, then own review to separately frozen output; no execution/compile/lint or overwrite. All existing rights retained; tar fields/API/constants carry compatibility lineage; no novelty/MIT/legal cleanroom claim.

Creation serially visits requested entries in input order, checking property presence with `sourcePath in entry` to choose source versus inline. Normalize supplied archive path via retained normalization port with options {unsafePathLabel:'unsafe plugin archive path'} before lstat or inline processing. Inline string UTF8 or copy Uint8Array to Buffer. Inline defaults mode0644 and mtimeMs current Date.now() when undefined. Metadata is appended LAST as a regular file .knorvia-plugin-sync.json, UTF8 JSON.stringify(metadata,null,2) plus newline, same defaults. Append1024 zero bytes and gzip concatenated tar via promisified node:zlib gzip, default options; return resulting Buffer typed Uint8Array. IO/unbounded gzip failures propagate same error object; do not wrap.

Source traversal is lstat (not stat), directories first emit header entry name with trailing slash, mode from stat, mtime floor(ms/1000), size0,type5. Then await readdir(source,{withFileTypes:true}), sort by name.localeCompare, descend serially for every child regardless dirent kind using native join source and posix.join archive then retained normalization. Symlinks/other lstat kinds reject Error(`unsupported plugin archive source: ${sourcePath}`), never follow/read. Regular file readFile then emit content with stat.mode/mtimeMs. Directory slash normalization applies to emitted name only; child path joins canonical archive path. File payload padded with zero bytes to next512 boundary; zero-length no padding. Duplicate paths/order are retained. No streaming/exclusion/dedup/checksum validation/pax/longlink expansion.

Format exactly512-byte zero-initialized USTAR headers; these byte fields are compatibility data, not private source design. Name UTF8 at0 length100; mode at100 length8: mode &0777; uid108 length8 zero; gid116 length8 zero; size124 length12; mtime136 length12 floor(ms/1000); checksum148 length8; type156 length1 '0' regular or '5' directory; magic257 length6 UTF8 'ustar' (final zero); version263 length2 '00'; uname265 length32 'knorvia'; gname297 length32 'knorvia'; prefix345 length155. Other bytes0. Octal numeric representation value.toString(8), leftpad length-1 with '0', followed NUL; values longer than length-1 throw same header-value-too-long error (no truncation/clamp except mode mask). UTF8 string overflow Error(`plugin archive header value is too long: ${value}`). For checksum treat148..155 as eight spaces, sum bytes then write6-char leftpadded octal at148..153,NUL154,space155.

Path fitting: UTF8 bytes <=100 => whole name,prefix empty. Otherwise choose rightmost slash split with prefix UTF8 bytes <=155 and suffix UTF8 bytes <=100, testing splits from final separator backward; prefix/suffix formed by segments.join('/'). Directory final slash can give empty name with whole directory sans final slash as prefix, if it fits155. No valid split=>Error(`plugin archive path is too long: ${entryPath}`). Metadata header formatting same as other regular files. Gzip mtime/default behavior remains Node port-owned.

Extraction: resolve(targetDir), mkdir(root,{recursive:true}) FIRST, before decompression including failure/limit. options default{}. Read maxExtractedBytes once. Without defined limit, promisified gunzip(Buffer.from(archive)) and native error identity. With defined limit, gunzip(Buffer.from(archive),{maxOutputLength: maxExtractedBytes+1024+512*512}); any rejection is wrapped in new Error('plugin sync archive exceeds limit: '+(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error))). Negative/NaN/other supplied numbers are not prevalidated. Whole decompressed Buffer then read complete512-byte headers from start, stop on ANYallzero header; trailing incomplete header bytes ignored. No checksum/USTAR magic validation. Numeric text: stop at firstNUL,UTF8,trim, Number.parseInt(text,8), empty=>0; preserve native parseNaN behavior. Header size124/12 defines payload. If start+size>buffer.length throw Error('truncated plugin sync archive entry') before type/path checks. Cursor advances payload rounded up to512 irrespective content type, even if padding lies beyond end. Directory payload size not counted to extracted file limit. Read type156/1 as first-NUL text; falsey=> '0'. Name0/100 and prefix345/155 first-NULUTF8; prefix nonempty=>prefix+'/'+name. Normalize combined archive path through retained port SAME custom unsafe label, then resolve target via retained guarded resolver with same label, before entry type dispatch or budget guard.

Type5 => mkdir(target,{recursive:true}). Type0 or NUL => add header file size to cumulative extractedBytes, then if defined limit and cumulative>limit reject Error(`plugin sync archive exceeds limit: ${extractedBytes}/${maxExtractedBytes}`) before parent/file writes. Mode from100/8 parsed as above: finite positive =>mode &0777, otherwise0644. mkdir(dirname(target),{recursive:true}), writeFile(target,payload,{mode:fileMode}); if process.platform!='win32' then chmod(target,fileMode) restores archive bits despite umask. Preserve callback failure/error identity and sequence. Other type rejects Error(`unsupported plugin archive entry type: ${typeFlag}`) AFTER path containment, no type-specific write. No rm/rollback/metadata parsing/mode hardening/additional symlink policy/realpath (path and permission authorities unchanged). No actual extraction/source filesystem operations during author work.

# External value/error/port ordering clarifications, original packet retained

Read only prior designated public packets, this file and own outputs; no repository/test/dependency bodies or execution/compile. Write separately frozen revision-02/pluginSyncArchive.ts with receipt and own static review. Preserve all raw/review files.

Numeric header overflow Error text interpolates the encoded left-padded octal STRING (without final NUL), not the numeric decimal value. Example oversized mtime floor(ms/1000) error ends in that number.toString(8). Same field width and overflow boundaries; don't clamp or reinterpret.

Property reads are observable on the public entry objects: first query `sourcePath in entry` to choose branch. Source branch reads sourcePath before archivePath normalization; inline branch normalizes archivePath before reading content. Inline content uses typeof getter then reads it again for Buffer conversion according to the chosen branch. Inline mode and mtimeMs each read ONCE after content conversion, defaults0644/Date.now only when undefined. No new validation or reordering. Source child name ports are read for native source join before archive posix join/normalization, then lstat receives the paired paths. Getter failures/errors propagate unchanged.

Retained path authority uses identical options label; it is not an authoring target. Complete owner's private helpers/data design free; these are externally required argument/read/error semantics, not private frame instructions. Keep all budget/mkdir/chmod/metadata/error policy behavior unchanged.
